name: Hollow Glass
description: Rounded triangle tone with a faint shimmer above.

name: Warm Square
description: Muffled square wave with a low saw underneath.

name: Juno Mono
description: Punchy analog mono lead with a quick filter blip.

name: Quiet Fifths
description: Pure sine with a soft fifth ringing above it.

name: Dusk Square
description: Dark square with a soft pluck at the start of each note.

name: Chip Pulse
description: Plain square wave, like an old console.

name: Arcade Triangle
description: Soft console triangle with a quick vibrato.

name: Robot Choir
description: Vowel-like synth voice, vocoder flavored.

name: Pocket Chip
description: Thin, nasal pulse like a handheld console.

name: Wavetable Chip
description: Crunchy, stepped console wave.

name: Octave Chip
description: Square doubled an octave up for a bright arcade sound.

name: Talkbox
description: Saw through a moving vowel filter, a little "wah" on every note.

name: Space Marimba
description: Woody, soft mallet tone.

name: Crystal Pluck
description: Bright plucked synth with bouncing echoes.

name: Star Music Box
description: Tiny, high, metallic music box.

name: Distant Chime
description: Soft chime that rings for ages.

name: Electric Piano
description: Soft, round FM electric piano.

name: Space Harp
description: Clean, ringing harp strings.

name: Tiny Bell
description: Small, high bell with bouncing echoes.

name: Soft Mallet
description: Muted wooden mallet, very gentle.

name: Warm Analog Pad
description: Classic analog pad that slowly opens up.

name: Frozen Choir
description: Hollow, choir-like synth voices.

name: Low Orbit
description: Deep, round sine with a sub underneath.

name: Choir of Glass
description: Glassy voices over a hollow low tone.

name: Broken Transmission
description: Stuttering, fast-warbling square.

name: Sonar Ping
description: Deep sonar blip that echoes into the dark.

name: Warm Tape Sub
description: Deep sub pushed through tape-style saturation, so it is felt and heard.

name: Soft Felt
description: Muffled, gentle, almost like a felt piano played low.

name: Fretless
description: Singing, sliding bass with a vocal "mwah" on each note.

name: Tuba Synth
description: Soft brass bass that swells into each note.

name: Space Cello Bass
description: Bowed synth bass with a slow, gentle vibrato.

name: 808 Boom
description: Deep hip-hop style boom: a thump that drops in pitch and rings out, lightly saturated.

name: Wobble
description: Filter that throbs a few times per second. Big and unsettled.

name: Crushed Chip
description: Low square wave crunched down to a few steps, like a broken console.

name: Viola Voice
description: Hollow, reedy and singing, a little higher and softer.

name: Low Glass
description: Glassy tone over a soft sub, a little bell-like.

name: Deep Pluck
description: Plucked, like a melodic bass guitar that rings out.

name: Sub Whistle
description: Pure low sine with gentle saturation so it carries.

name: Clean Saw
description: A plain, bright saw with the edge taken off. No wobble.

name: Clean Square
description: A smooth, hollow square wave.

name: Soft Pulse
description: A narrow pulse wave, nasal but clean.

name: Round Sine
description: A pure sine with a soft octave above it. Very clean.

name: Mellow Triangle
description: Warm and gentle, like a quiet flute synth.

name: Poly Synth
description: A classic warm analog synth with a soft filter bloom.

name: 4-bit Triangle
description: The old console triangle channel: stepped and soft.

name: 4-bit Saw
description: A saw crunched down to a handful of steps.

name: Crunchy Square
description: A gritty, lo-fi square.

name: 8-bit Pulse
description: Handheld-console pulse with a quick chip vibrato.

name: Wave Channel
description: A stepped custom wave, like a Game Boy wave channel.

name: Bitcrushed Voice
description: A hollow voice crushed into a lo-fi robot tone.

name: 909 Kit
description: Classic drum machine: tight thumping kick, snappy snare, crisp hats, clap.

name: 808 Kit
description: Deep booming kick, round snare, metallic hats, the famous clap and rim.

name: Acoustic Room
description: Closest to a real drummer: a round kick with beater, a snare with wires, ringing hats, in a room.

name: Brushes
description: Jazz brushes: a soft kick, a swishing snare, whispered hats. Very gentle.

name: Lo-fi Tape
description: Dusty, warm, slightly crunchy drums, like an old cassette of a drum break.

name: Minimal Tech
description: Short, precise and dry: a tight kick, clicky rims, tiny hats.

name: Trap Kit
description: A long, heavy 808 boom, a sharp snare and clap, very crisp hats.

name: Cinematic
description: Huge and dangerous: a deep boom, a snare with a long tail, a taiko-like drum.
